evidence_class: code inspection + fixture tests + frozen historical artifacts (development_only)

stages.name: raw market data
stages.finding: OK — 25-symbol pilot cohort, dates 2016-2026; verified latest session 2026-10-29

stages.name: adjusted market data
stages.finding: OK — single adjustment convention applied at import; no raw/adjusted mixing found in feature or label paths

stages.name: feature generation
stages.finding: OK — 22 frozen features, bars strictly <= decision date (cutoff index), train-median NaN fill, train-only scaler

stages.name: model input
stages.source: StandardScaler fit on train partition only
stages.finding: OK — no test statistics leak into scaling

stages.name: model output
stages.source: cls_fit101 RandomForest predict_proba (P(net>0)); historical direction models predict forward return
stages.finding: OK — output is a probability for cost-aware models; return-regression models output fraction-of-price returns

stages.name: prediction horizon
stages.source: task100 horizons 5/10/21d; trade labels 21-session engine horizon
stages.finding: CONSISTENT WITHIN each protocol; direction models (5/10/21d) and trade labels (21-session TP/SL) are DIFFERENT targets — see task105_target_semantics_audit.json

stages.name: probability/confidence transformation
stages.finding: calibrated probabilities valid by construction on validation; OOS association ~0 (Task 104) — reproduced in Phase 6

stages.name: BUY/SELL/HOLD mapping
stages.source: ensemble.ts (avgRet>+1% BUY, <-1% SELL); ai-model-signals route (EMA/RSI rules); cost-aware filter: no direction — take/skip long trade
stages.finding: MAPPING DIRECTIONALLY CORRECT; SELL/SHORT signals are DISPLAYED and SIMULATED although PSX retail has no verified short-selling rights — flagged as capital-protection issue, not a sign defect

stages.name: entry timestamp
stages.finding: OK — decision date is the information cutoff; entry is the NEXT session's open

stages.name: ATR calculation
stages.finding: OK — uses historical candles up to cutoff only; fixture-tested

stages.name: SL calculation
stages.finding: OK — direction-correct on both sides (fixture suite risk_levels_buy/sell_geometry)

stages.name: TP1/TP2/TP3
stages.source: risk-levels.ts: entry +/- {1,1.5,2}xATR (tp3 at 2x per policy string 1-1.5-2-3)

stages.name: position sizing
stages.finding: OK — whole shares, cash-constrained, no leverage

stages.name: exit strategy
stages.source: strategy-engine.ts (SL-first same-candle, gap-aware, TP3 terminal, step-trailing, 50/25/25, TIME_UP@21)

stages.name: execution simulation
stages.source: strategy-engine.ts + task104_portfolio_sim.ts (exits before entries same session)
stages.finding: OK — daily-bar realism limitation documented; no intraday data exists

stages.name: fee calculation
stages.finding: OK — parity-tested in Task 103/104 and Phase 12

stages.name: final net P&L
stages.source: net = gross - costs per leg; portfolio ledger identity verified

defects_found.title: SELL/SHORT signals displayed and simulated without verified short-selling rights
defects_found.affected_production_surface: ai-model-signals route, Investment Simulator (simTrade direction=SELL), ensemble SELL mapping
defects_found.historical_impact: NONE on Task 100-104 results — all 11,521 historical label trades are BUY-only
defects_found.action: Task 105 policy layer marks short-capable signals research_only; UI disclosure added (Phase 10)

defects_found.title: Uncalibrated confidence displayed as if actionable
defects_found.affected_production_surface: ai-model-signals confidence formula (55+min(30,|rsi-50|)) is a heuristic score, not a probability
defects_found.historical_impact: none on labels; misleads users if read as win probability

sign_defects_found: NONE — no evidence of reversed predictions, mis-scaled targets, or wrong-horizon conflation in the execution path
